A focused UI test passed left-swipe deletion without confirmation, persistence after relaunch, preserving another editable profile and opening a historical reading. The signed Release build passed with zero warnings, and 3.0.9 / 35 was installed in place and launched on 穷奇. Broader 406-unit/ten-live-scenario evidence remains under its tested 3.0.7 version. TestFlight upload is handled separately after this local verification.

Chat button removal 3.0.8 / Build 34: removed Back to latest from the conversation screen and updated its README description. One existing iPad scrolling/composer UI regression passed; its after-scroll screenshot confirms no floating button. The signed Release build passed with zero warnings, signature/version/resource checks passed, and the app was updated in place on 穷奇 (iPhone 15 Plus). Online Agent and experience fixes 3.0.7 / Build 33: 406 non-live unit tests, 6 iPad UI regressions and 24 configuration/version script tests passed. Ten synthetic real DeepSeek conversation scenarios were replayed, followed by focused language, pending-interaction, profile-retraction, method-selection and repeated-redraw retests. Final redraw synthesis was manually checked against all three confirmed cards and orientations; prior failed state/semantic attempts remain in build/online-agent-audit. All production interpretations require the fixed online Agent; provider/model/credential/offline controls are removed. Streaming permits viewing saved results, and confirmed history clearing preserves profiles/readings while removing conversations and unfinished drafts. The final unsigned iPhoneOS Release build passed with zero compiler warnings; version, bundle ID, managed credential resource presence and retired resource absence were checked without exposing secrets. No physical-device installation or store upload was performed. Earlier evidence below retains its actual tested version.

Method activation fix 3.0.6 / Build 32: 383 non-live unit tests, four iPhone continuation UI tests, and two opt-in live provider tests passed. All ten methods were checked for first requests and additions to existing readings, with real local results and required card/coin interactions. Screenshot wording now activates Tarot after Meihua with both DeepSeek and Qwen. Mocked planner reply/intake errors, missing personal details, method-only changes, fresh questions, pending additions and participant changes are covered. The unsigned iPhoneOS Release build passed without compiler warnings. Earlier evidence below retains its actual tested version. No physical-device installation or store upload was performed.

Archive version, bundle identifier, signature, both packaged provider credentials, location dataset and English/Chinese localization resources were verified. District and clock intake 3.0.4 / Build 30: 132 focused non-live unit tests and two iPhone simulator UI tests passed. Ten synthetic birthplace/clock combinations cover eight districts, duplicate Chaoyang names, optional provinces, Pudong New Area and Chengdu aliases, multiple date spellings, leap day, dotted AM/PM, 24-hour clocks, seconds, noon and midnight. Four district combinations were also checked in the English confirmation UI, alongside the original city-only question. District hierarchy and catalog coordinates are retained; contradictory country/province paths, truncated model proposals and relatives' labeled facts cannot bind an unrelated district. Live provider requests and physical-device installation were not rerun. Result: build/district-time-prefill-3.0.4-final.xcresult.

English intake prefill 3.0.3 / Build 29: 140 focused non-live unit tests and two iPhone simulator UI tests passed. The exact Alex Chen career question prefills chart sex, June 15, 1995, 9:30 AM and Shanghai in the English confirmation form. Regressions cover dotted AM/PM, noon/midnight, labeled birth dates, negation, uncertainty, unrelated event/work locations and separate people. The editable form applies the existing default timezone without changing the raw extracted profile or an explicit non-default zone. Live provider requests and physical-device installation were not rerun. Result: build/english-prefill-3.0.3.xcresult.

Conversation understanding 2.0.12 / Build 25: 351 non-live unit tests and the unsigned Release build passed. Mocked store regressions cover a text-only topic over an unrelated older reading, retry across relaunch, returning to an older reading, rejecting a foreign conversation reference, changing participants, and blocking an unrelated person from a resolved question. Final DeepSeek and Qwen planner checks passed all six synthetic cases for period, topic, and participant references. The store tests verify that a planner intake suggestion for a verified continuation does not open the form.

Natural reading voice 2.0.11 / Build 24: 29 AI service tests passed. DeepSeek and Qwen each returned eight Chinese samples across the four voices and both reply routes. None of the 16 samples used the discouraged betting or theatrical openings. All four Deadpan samples opened with a direct answer, and one DeepSeek initial reading used four sentences. The signed Release build was installed and version-checked on the physical iPhone.

Reading voices 2.0.10 / Build 23: 46 focused non-live tests passed, including the request format and four voice settings for both providers. Two iPad simulator UI tests passed for the default fallback and selection persistence. Two live tests on the iPhone simulator returned 16 synthetic samples across DeepSeek and Qwen, covering all four voices in both synthesis and follow-up. Manual review found direct openings and distinct styles, with 15 replies of two or three sentences and one five-sentence Qwen follow-up. The signed Release build was installed and version-checked on the physical iPhone.

Interruptible analysis 2.0.9 / Build 22: 345 non-live unit tests and six chat progress UI tests passed on the iOS 26.5 iPhone 17 Pro simulator (Xcode 27.2). Nine opt-in live API tests were skipped. The UI verified completing an answer in the background, sending a follow-up during output, and retrying after termination and relaunch. The unsigned Release build passed. The iOS 26 continued-processing grant was not tested on a physical device.

Saved-profile reuse update 0.1.6 / Build 7: 219 non-live unit tests and five UI regressions passed; three opt-in live tests skipped. Existing named profiles retain UUID, birthday, wall-clock time, confirmed birth timezone and location. Empty AI participant arrays and missing name selections cannot hide grounded saved records; a sole saved person is only a visible form candidate, without automatic self binding. Incomplete non-declared-unknown draft fields are repaired from the matching saved UUID while intentional known edits and explicit unknowns remain. Birth timezone restoration preserves the local clock. Synthetic saved-profile → unqualified fortune question → prefilled form → one confirmation → coins/result, timezone selection, multi-person and followup flows verified. Final Debug tests and unsigned Release archive completed with zero warnings; live DeepSeek/physical GPS were not rerun. Other broader UI evidence below retains its earlier version.

New readings open one complete form with all selected people inline and any requested numbers; one successful submit directly starts the reading or required card/coin operation. Missing required data stays in the same form with combined feedback. Searchable Chinese timezone selection, independent birth/current location, saved birthdays, draft recovery, stale callbacks, history, tarot/coin continuity, multi-person inputs and ordinary follow-ups verified. Final Debug builds and unsigned Release archive completed with zero warnings. Live DeepSeek/physical GPS were not rerun; older evidence below retains its original version.

Final Debug builds and unsigned Release archive completed with zero warnings; older evidence below retains its original version.

fixes.streaming: Incremental Unicode-scalar JSON decoder preserves combining marks, emoji, escaped surrogate pairs, and selects only the top-level text property.
fixes.history: A malformed conversation does not hide valid chats; recovery backups are deduplicated within the vault instance and fallback writes are blocked if preservation fails.
fixes.lifecycle: Persist before interpretation and on scene background; retain checkpointed partial replies and cancel stale progress in both messages and runs after restart.
fixes.location: Each request has its own CLLocationManager; old coordinate, authorization and error callbacks are rejected after cancellation or replacement.

ui_flows: Unified form submission proceeds to six coin casts and local results.
Birth location shortcut preserves independent current location and survives relaunch.
Follow-up reuses the saved reading across relaunch without new intake.
Background checkpoint survives process termination and relaunch without a running spinner or empty reply.
remaining_limits: Only the text received by the background checkpoint is durable until the request finishes; later unsaved chunks can be lost if the process is terminated.
JSON files are individually atomic; cross-file transactions and incremental conversation persistence remain planned work.
Minimum-supported-OS and physical-device background-termination checks were not run in this batch.

changes: Answer the current question in the first sentence; give a clear leaning when saved results support a distinction.
Explain the judgment with one or two specific available clues; do not force chart evidence into pure terminology or ordinary conversation.
Replace generic reassurance and repeated hedges with the main obstacle, advantage, action and relevant conditions.
Keep material limitations scoped to the affected question; clearly state what cannot be judged rather than inventing certainty.
Use substantive conflict-option titles and distinguishable conditions; preserve real disagreement.
Usually target 250 to 400 Chinese characters for initial synthesis; short answers may be shorter and follow-ups answer only what was asked.
